description: Compare 2 to 5 hospitals side by side on CMS overall stars, patient survey stars, the share of patients rating it 9 or 10 and who would recommend it, ER median time, left before being seen, sepsis care and mortality, safety and readmission measures better or worse than national. Names which hospital leads each.

hospitals.description: 2 to 5 hospitals, each { facility_id } or { name, state } (city optional).

facility_id.description: CMS facility id (CCN), 6 characters such as 220071. Best when known (hospital_search returns it).

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, such as "Mass General" or "Brigham and Women's".

state.description: State code or name. Narrows a name lookup.

name: hospital_compare
title: Compare hospitals
